scripts.text:
[Est]
Focus on the briefing.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
專心聽簡報。

scripts.text:
## Received Message ##
## Team Alpha's last communication was at Oscar Sierra 52 177 ##
scripts.translation:
## 收到資訊 ##
## 阿爾法小隊最後通訊地點：奧斯卡·西耶拉 52 177 ##

scripts.text: ## Enter Message Input ##
scripts.translation: ## 輸入資訊 ##

scripts.text: ## Enter Message Input ##
scripts.translation: ## 輸入資訊 ##

scripts.text: ## No Communication Status ##
scripts.translation: ## 無通訊狀態 ##

scripts.text: ## Send Message Input ##
scripts.translation: ## 傳送資訊 ##

scripts.text: There is no trace of alpha. Only the radio.
scripts.translation: 沒找到阿爾法小隊，只剩下一部無線電

scripts.text: Nothing in particular.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼特別的

scripts.text: ## Coordinates Received ##
scripts.translation: ## 收到座標 ##

scripts.text: ^0000FFI think he stopped breathing.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000FF他似乎已經沒了呼吸。^000000

scripts.text:
[???]
Krrr. I guess you're not someone of Regenschirm. Can you move aside, I have something to say to that person.
scripts.translation:
[???]
咕嚕...你應該不是雷根修蘆的人。
讓一讓，我有話要跟那個人說。

scripts.text: ^0000FFThe mutant who's life is running out is trying to say something.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000FF那個生命垂危的變異者似乎想說什麼。^000000

scripts.text:
[Est]
{0}, I didn't think I'd survive and see you again. You're pretty good.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
{0}，沒想到我還能活著見到你。你做得不錯。

scripts.text: Ask about the fallen mutant.
scripts.translation: 詢問關於倒下的變異者

scripts.text:
[Est]
Well, even if you ask me... it's the first time that I'll talk to a mutant.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
嗯，就算你問我...這也是我第一次和變異者說話。

scripts.text:
[Est]
How do you know my name? Who are you! I'll finish you painlessly, so be honest.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
你怎麼知道我的名字？你到底是誰！
老實交代，我讓你死個痛快。

scripts.text:
[???]
Est... Rebellion Ghost Squad... Do you remember uncle Miguel?
scripts.translation:
[???]
埃斯特...反叛者幽靈小隊...你還記得米格爾叔叔嗎？

scripts.text:
[Est]
How do you know that name...
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
你怎麼知道那個名字...

scripts.text:
[???]
Ha... haha... you still remember.
^0000FFThe identification tag on the mutant's neck stands out.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000FF變異者脖子上的身份牌很顯眼。^000000

scripts.text: Get the identification tag and hand it to Est.
scripts.translation: 取下身份牌交給埃斯特

scripts.text:
[Est]
Mi... guel...?
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
米...米格爾...？

scripts.text:
[Miguel]
... Est, the last thing I'll see... is your face... That's a relief.
scripts.translation:
[米格爾]
...埃斯特，臨死前最後看到的...是你的臉...真好。

scripts.text:
[Est]
Uncle Miguel!? How did this happen!
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
米格爾叔叔！？怎麼會這樣！

scripts.text:
[Miguel]
Before I die... I always wanted to see my old colleagues... You fulfilled my wish.
scripts.translation:
[米格爾]
死之前...一直想再見見老戰友...你替我了了這個心願。

scripts.text:
[Est]
Uncle! What is this! What happened to you?
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
叔叔！這是怎麼回事！你怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Miguel]
Ugh... I don't have much time left... Listen carefully, Est.
scripts.translation:
[米格爾]
呃...我快不行了...埃斯特，聽好了。

scripts.text:
[Miguel]
Somewhere in here... the mad research results of Regenschirm... can be found somewhere in here.
scripts.translation:
[米格爾]
這裡的某個地方...藏著雷根修蘆那些瘋狂的研究成果...就在這裡某處。

scripts.text:
[Miguel]
Find everything... and you'll know what happened to me... you'll see things that can't be explained here.
scripts.translation:
[米格爾]
把那些東西都找出來...就知道我為什麼變成這樣了...有些事，在這裡說不清...

scripts.text:
[Est]
Uncle! Wake up!! Let's go out. If we go out, we can save you!
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
叔叔！醒醒！！我們出去吧。只要出去，就能救你！

scripts.text:
[Miguel]
Est... you still have a big heart... that kind of feeling... on the battlefield... I taught you...
scripts.translation:
[米格爾]
埃斯特...你還是這麼心軟...這種感情...在戰場上...我教過你...

scripts.text:
[Est]
Uncle! Uncle!!
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
叔叔！叔叔！！

scripts.text:
[Miguel]
...
Ask about Miguel
scripts.translation: 詢問關於米格爾的事

scripts.text:
[Est]
{0}, I'm sorry but I don't feel like talking about him right now.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
{0}，抱歉，我現在不想談論他。

scripts.text: Ask about the records.
scripts.translation: 詢問關於記錄的事

scripts.text:
[Est]
I checked the northeast section and saw a place over the railway that seemed to be a research facility.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
我查看了東北一帶，在鐵軌另一邊發現了一處像是研究設施的地方。

scripts.text:
[Est]
Maybe the research Miguel was talking about... is somewhere in there. I'm going to have to start another operation right away.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
米格爾說的研究...可能就在那裡。
得馬上展開下一次行動。

scripts.text:
[Est]
I don't think there will be anything else to do here.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
我覺得這裡沒有其他事可做了。

scripts.text: I want to go back.
scripts.translation: 我想回去

scripts.text:
[Operation Officer]
You've dealt with a CP7 Mutant by yourself... did the battle went well?
scripts.translation:
[作戰官]
你獨自對付了一個CP7變異者...戰鬥還順利吧？

scripts.text:
[Operation Officer]
Here are the supplies and experience given to the troops that joined the operation. Take it.
scripts.translation:
[作戰官]
這是發給參戰人員的補給和經驗值，收下吧。

scripts.text:
[Operation Officer]
Even though it's a CP7 Rated, sorry I couldn't give you more experience.
scripts.translation:
[作戰官]
對手可是CP7評級，卻沒法給你更多經驗值，真抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Operation Officer]
Let's go out now. We need to prepare for repairs quickly.
scripts.translation:
[作戰官]
我們現在就出去吧。需要儘快準備修復工作。

scripts.text: Look around more.
scripts.translation: 再四處看看

scripts.text: Go Out
scripts.translation: 出去

scripts.text:
[Operation Officer]
Is that so? Don't delay it for too long.
scripts.translation:
[作戰官]
是嗎？那就別耽擱太久了。
